page.layout: No printed text blocks. The scan shows the blank front wrapper of a limp vellum binding, with a spine label at the left edge. The library's measuring scale and label at the right and the digitiser's footer are not printed text.
page.notes: Blank wrapper, not a printed page. The only marks are on the spine label at the left edge, which is handwritten or stuck-on binding text and partly cut off (fragments such as "un", "tt", "io", "32"). These are not printed on this page and are not transcribed. The Herzog August Bibliothek scale and label at the right, and the HAB/DFG footer, are digitiser material and are left out.
